pleased to state:

Government of Madhya Pradesh has
submitted proposals to the Central

pleased to state:

constituted by her Ministry in October last
year with the responsibility of making
recommendations to the Ministry for
framing a National Culture Policy and was
asked to study, among other things, the
extent and role of Government in various

mandate for various cultural institutions;

the report; and

embankments in Orissa

MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:

Orissa has requested the Centre for grant

Development of pilot training

(a) the details of pilot training  institutes

(b) whether it is a fact that paucity of
such institutes leads to Indian youths having
to spend a fortune on getting the said
training abroad;

problem;

infrastructure available in the country does

Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION

X-ray machines at metro airports in the

Government would stop such practice,

in Indian sky under various airlines;
(d) whether it is also a fact that the
qualification and medical norms for holding
a commercial license under Indian norms

norms became eligible according to norms

in Indian sky?

be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has decided to
constitute the Thirteenth Finance

Money spent on compilation of CAG
report

SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:

and Auditor General (CAG) report go

722. SHRI MANOHAR JOSHI: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be

agreement between Indian Airlines and Air
Corporation Employees Union it was

all In-Flight Service (IFS) officers would
be promoted as Assistant Manager (IFS);

Service officers would be promoted as
Assistant Manager (IFS);

the agreement all officers of 9A Grade in all
departments, other than the department of

Department of IFS would be promoted; and

airlines

the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be

airlines are contemplating a hike in fuel
surcharge levied on each ticket; and
(b) if so, what is the basis and the extent
of hike?
 Airport Economic Regulatory
Authority Bill

Bill is ready for introduction in Parliament
